title: Fig, gorgonzo and prosciutto salad
preamble:
3.0 tbsp olive oil

1.0 tbsp balsamic vinegar

4 ripe figs , halved

100.0g Gorgonzola or dolcelatte , roughly sliced

6 slices prosciutto
method: Whisk together the olive oil and balsamic vinegar and season. Arrange
the figs, cheese, prosciutto and watercress on two plates.
Drizzle with the dressing and serve.
